info.name: NIST NVD CVE Cvehistory Cves API

params.name: cveId
params.description: Returns a single CVE record by its CVE identifier.

params.name: cpeName
params.description: Returns CVE records associated with the supplied CPE 2.3 name.

params.name: cvssV3Severity
params.description: Filter results by CVSS v3 qualitative severity rating.

params.name: keywordSearch
params.description: Returns CVE records where the description contains the keyword.

params.name: pubStartDate
params.description: Filter by CVE publish start date (ISO 8601).

params.name: pubEndDate
params.description: Filter by CVE publish end date (ISO 8601).

params.name: lastModStartDate
params.description: Filter by last modified start date (ISO 8601).

params.name: lastModEndDate
params.description: Filter by last modified end date (ISO 8601).

params.name: resultsPerPage
params.description: Number of CVE records to return per page (max 2000).

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based offset into the result set.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of CVE records that match the supplied filter parameters. Supports filters by CVE ID, keyword, CPE, CVSS metrics, publication and modification dates.
